messages:
mira: FYI I'm going to run an SLO-aware spot bidding canary in us-west1 tomorrow. Plan: capacity-optimized for high-slo (api/generation), price-optimized for batch (embeddings). Want input on max_price % and fallback order.

sam: SGTM. What max_price are you thinking?

jorge: Also need to compute expected preemption_rate for capacity-optimized. Our historical preemptions in us-west1 are ~3.2% p90 last 30d. If we push max_price too low we lose capacity.

lee: Can we avoid double-cost by pre-warming a tiny on-demand pool for cold starts? even a 1-2 node always-on buffer?

mira: Yes. Proposed policy (example):
```yaml
bid_policies:
  - pool: gen-high-slo
    strategy: capacity-optimized
    max_price_pct: 95
    preempt_tolerance_pct: 5
    fallback: [reserved, ondemand]
  - pool: embeddings-batch
    strategy: price-optimized
    max_price_pct: 60
    fallback: [spot, ondemand]

# autoscaler config
spare_capacity_pct: 5 # maintain 5% spare for p95 latency SLO
warm_buffer_ttl_mins: 10
```

mira: Key notes: capacity-optimized for gen because latency SLO, price-optimized for embeddings to save cost. Fallback order matters: for gen we want reserved/ondemand before dropping SLO.

sam: What metrics/alerts do we watch during the canary?

mira: preemption_rate, node_drain_rate, p95_inference_latency, cost_per_token. Temporary alert: preemption_rate > 8% for 15m => rollback. Also alert on p95_inference_latency > target * 1.2 for 10m.

infra-bot: Scheduled canary: 12h window starting 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Owner: mira. Canary id: cb-1862345678.

jorge: Slight concern: market correlation events can spike evictions across zones. Recommend region diversification for high-slo pools: [us-west1, us-west2, us-central1] and prefer different machine families if available.

lee: Also +1 on warm_buffer_ttl 10m to avoid thrash when spot nodes come back. And ensure rolling drain grace is >= 30s to preserve in-flight KV caches.

mira: Good calls. I'll add diversification and bump drain grace to 45s in the canary. After 12h we'll look at: 
- preemption_rate trend
- p95 latency vs baseline
- cost delta per-token
- number of fallback events (to on-demand/reserved)

mira: Action items: 1) I'll deploy canary tomorrow morning; 2) @sam please add temporary alerts to the eng-slo channel; 3) @jorge please run the preemption probability simulator with the new max_price_pct numbers; 4) @lee please validate autoscaler warm buffer behavior on small scale.

sam: Will do, adding alerts now.

jorge: I'll kick off the simulator and share results in this thread. Expect initial numbers in ~2h.

mira: Thanks team. I'll post the canary dashboard + playbook link once the job is running. :thumbsup:
